name: post.sync_cover
description: Gives a post the sync made its cover: the brand's own copy of the platform's image (media.create, then the upload), because Meta's image addresses expire. Only a posted post made outside Brand Base that has no media yet takes one; any other post is left as it is and nothing is answered. Called by the server's Make route, never by a screen or an agent's tool.
sql:
update brandbase.posts p set media = :media::jsonb
where p.id = :id and p.brand_id = :brand and p.marked = 'posted' and p.media = '[]'::jsonb
  and not exists (select 1 from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = p.id)
returning brandbase.post_json(p) as result
